For each process, using \(PV=nRT\) and \(T=kV^2\):
\[
P_i = nR k_i V
\]
so
\[
W_i=\int_{V_{i1}}^{V_{i2}} P_i\,dV
= nR k_i \int_{V_{i1}}^{V_{i2}} V\,dV
= \frac{nR k_i}{2}\left(V_{i2}^2-V_{i1}^2\right).
\]
Thus
\[
\frac{W_1}{W_2}
=
\frac{k_1\left(V_{1f}^2-V_{1i}^2\right)}
{k_2\left(V_{2f}^2-V_{2i}^2\right)}.
\]
Equivalently, since \(k_i(V_{if}^2-V_{ii}^2)=\Delta T_i\),
\[
\boxed{\frac{W_1}{W_2}=\frac{\Delta T_1}{\Delta T_2}}.
\]
